goal: Rotate the deploy key and restart the workers
why_human: The rotation invalidates running sessions, so a person decides when it happens.

steps.text: Open the machines page and restart every worker.
steps.warning: Restarting drops in-flight jobs; do it outside business hours.

steps.text: Check Windows notification settings if the restart alert does not appear.

verify: Call GET /healthz on every machine and check that all report the new key fingerprint.
